_manifest.description: Every event pdata has stopped tracking live, with its final result: the record pdata keeps when it prunes an event, 10 days after it closes. Events that closed between 2026-06-02 and 2026-08-11 are missing: they were pruned before the next backup was taken.
_manifest.as_of_note: When this export started. Rows are read over a few minutes; each row's own timestamp says when pdata last wrote it.
_manifest.format: JSON lines: this manifest, then one record per line.

fields.source: Venue: polymarket, kalshi, manifold, myriad, limitless, predict, opinion or gemini.
fields.id: The venue's event id, unique within source.
fields.title: Event title when pdata pruned it.
fields.categories: pdata topic categories (e.g. Politics, Sports), from rules and AI tagging.
fields.closed_time: When the event closed (UTC): the venue's close time, else its end date, else when pdata last saw it.
fields.markets: The event's top markets by lifetime volume, at most 10: id, question, result (as the venue reported it; null where the venue never says), final probability (0-1) and lifetime volume (venue unit).
fields.url: The event or market's own page on the venue's website; null when it cannot be built.
fields.pdata_url: pdata's page for the event, https://pdata.world/events/{source}/{id}.
fields.pruned_at: When pdata wrote this record (UTC): when it pruned the event, or 2026-10-07 for an event pruned before 2026-08-31 and rebuilt from backups.
